step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard depicts Epsagon's serverless architecture for processing and analyzing customer AWS Lambda metrics. The flow starts at a customer's Lambda function sending CloudWatch log data to an ingesting Kinesis Data Stream. A Transform Lambda reads from Kinesis, interacting bidirectionally with DynamoDB to fetch customer config and maintain state for partial invocations, then outputs formatted invocation records into a second Kinesis Data Stream. From there, two distinct paths process the data: (1) A writer Lambda consumes from Kinesis to write invocation records directly into Serverless Aurora for fast point-lookup querying. (2) Kinesis Data Firehose receives invocation records, applies data format conversion using schema definitions from AWS Glue, and outputs Parquet files into an S3 bucket data lake. Finally, Amazon Athena queries the aggregated data stored in S3.
